name: Kindjal
description: Every weapon shifted a dimension darker: melee that maims and launches, explosives that hit harder and throw worms much further, three new weapons (Acid Spitter, Acid Flask, Crucible) whose acid smokes and clings to a worm's skin, new names, new sounds. Content mod: every player in an online match needs it.

text.name: Acid Spitter
text.help: Spits a corrosive round. The burst is poison gas, and the acid clings to whatever it touches.

text.name: Acid Flask
text.help: Shatters where it lands and splashes acid to both sides. Poisons everything in the spill.

text.name: Crucible
text.help: No choir, no pause. Melts the ground it lands on and hurls everything nearby into the sky.

kWeaponBaseballBat.name: Nail Bat
kWeaponBaseballBat.help: A bat studded with nails. Hits harder and sends the victim flying.

kWeaponFirePunch.name: Hellfist
kWeaponFirePunch.help: An uppercut that detonates on contact and launches the victim.

kWeaponProd.name: Shiv
kWeaponProd.help: A stab that bleeds, with a shove behind it.

kWeaponNoMoreNails.name: Railspike
kWeaponNoMoreNails.help: Spikes driven straight in. Twice the hurt of a nail.

kWeaponBazooka.name: Ripper
kWeaponBazooka.help: A heavier rocket: bigger blast, far more knockback.

kWeaponGrenade.name: Pipe Bomb
kWeaponGrenade.help: Concentrated charge. Fewer victims, much deadlier.

kWeaponDynamite.name: Blast Keg
kWeaponDynamite.help: Clears a hillside and everyone on it.

kWeaponHolyHandGrenade.name: Profane Grenade
kWeaponHolyHandGrenade.help: The old miracle, stripped of mercy.

kWeaponBananaBomb.name: Plantain Hell
kWeaponBananaBomb.help: Splits into seven bomblets that throw worms around.

kWeaponClusterGrenade.name: Nail Cluster
kWeaponClusterGrenade.help: Every fragment now hurts and shoves.

kWeaponLandmine.name: Bear Trap
kWeaponLandmine.help: Stepping on one is a real event.

kWeaponHomingMissile.name: Harpoon
kWeaponHomingMissile.help: Guided displacement. Pulls worms off their perches.

kWeaponAirstrike.name: Carpet Bombing
kWeaponAirstrike.help: Heavier bombs, bigger craters, worms in the air.

kWeaponSuperAirstrike.name: Carrion Drop
kWeaponSuperAirstrike.help: Three carcasses from the sky. Nothing walks away.

kWeaponConcreteDonkey.name: Earthquake Ass
kWeaponConcreteDonkey.help: Cataclysmic terrain loss. Everything near it is airborne.

kWeaponSheep.name: Rabid Flock
kWeaponSheep.help: The sheep that ends a worm.

kWeaponSuperSheep.name: Plague Ram
kWeaponSuperSheep.help: Flies like the old one, kills like the new one.

kWeaponOldWoman.name: Hangwoman
kWeaponOldWoman.help: Shuffles over and throws everyone off the ledge.

kWeaponScouser.name: Knifeman
kWeaponScouser.help: Hits harder and shoves when he bursts.

kWeaponFatkins.name: Gorger
kWeaponFatkins.help: Lands like a meteor; the whole area goes flying.

kWeaponStarburst.name: Dead Star
kWeaponStarburst.help: A falling star that hurls worms across the map.

kWeaponShotgun.name: Slug Gun
kWeaponShotgun.help: Two slugs, fifty each. Both land, the worm dies.

kWeaponSniperRifle.name: Elephant Gun
kWeaponSniperRifle.help: The impact matters more than the hole.

kWeaponSentryGun.name: Gibbet Turret
kWeaponSentryGun.help: A turret that fires Ripper-class rounds.

kWeaponPoisonArrow.name: Plague Arrow
kWeaponPoisonArrow.help: Hits harder; the plague cloud is unchanged.
